quests.dispatcherQuestion: Thirty diners report stomach pain and vomiting after eating at the same restaurant tonight. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should happen to the restaurant right away.
quests.explanation: Closing the restaurant stops any more customers from eating food that may be causing the illness.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Health inspectors need to identify which dish on the menu is making people sick. Input code!
quests.hint: Ask for the official trained to investigate this.
quests.explanation: A health inspector can test the kitchen and ingredients to find the exact source of contamination.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Inspectors trace the illness to chicken that was left unrefrigerated overnight. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should be pulled from use.
quests.explanation: Recalling the specific batch stops the contaminated chicken from being served anywhere else.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A tour bus has broken down on a mountain road as night and cold set in. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what vehicle is needed to move the passengers.
quests.explanation: A rescue bus can move all the passengers to safety and warmth without them waiting in the cold.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: One elderly passenger is showing early signs of hypothermia while they wait. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Ask for the vehicle that carries paramedics to come.
quests.explanation: Paramedics can begin warming him safely and check for other symptoms right away.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: All passengers have been safely transferred to the replacement bus and are warming up. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should be confirmed to close out the call.
quests.explanation: A final headcount confirms nobody was left behind on the original broken-down bus.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A warehouse fire is producing thick black smoke that's drifting toward nearby homes. Input code!
quests.hint: Say the safety instruction for nearby homes.
quests.explanation: Staying inside with windows shut protects residents from breathing in the smoke while crews fight the fire.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Firefighters need extra water pressure to reach the flames on the warehouse roof. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what additional resource is needed.
quests.explanation: A second engine adds the water pressure and hose length needed to reach flames high on a roof.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The fire is out and air quality readings near the homes are back to normal. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should happen to the earlier instruction.
quests.explanation: Lifting the instruction once readings are normal lets residents open windows and go about their day again.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A car has crashed through a shop's front window on a busy high street. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Send help trained to treat injuries.
quests.explanation: Anyone struck by the car or hit by broken glass needs a paramedic assessment right away.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The shop's ceiling looks unstable after the crash and could still collapse. Input safety code!
quests.hint: Say what should happen around the damaged shop.
quests.explanation: Keeping people back protects them from a ceiling that may not be stable enough to enter yet.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A structural engineer confirms the shop ceiling is now safe to work under. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what can now happen once it's confirmed safe.
quests.explanation: Crews can only go in to clear debris once an engineer confirms the ceiling won't come down.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A sudden hailstorm has smashed skylights at a busy shopping center, showering glass on shoppers. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should be done with shoppers near the glass.
quests.explanation: Moving shoppers away from falling and broken glass is the first step before anything else.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Several shoppers have minor cuts from the falling glass. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Say what team can treat minor injuries on site.
quests.explanation: On-site first aid staff can treat several minor cuts quickly without needing a full ambulance for each person.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: One shopper has a deeper cut on her arm that won't stop bleeding. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Say who needs to reach the patient quickly.
quests.explanation: A cut that won't stop bleeding needs proper paramedic treatment beyond basic first aid.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A landslide has blocked the only road into a small village after days of rain. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what's needed to open the blocked road.
quests.explanation: Heavy clearance equipment can remove the debris safely and reopen the only route in or out.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A resident inside the village urgently needs a hospital dialysis appointment today. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what can reach him when the road is blocked.
quests.explanation: A helicopter can reach him quickly for his appointment while the road remains impassable.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The road has been cleared enough for regular vehicles to pass carefully. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what can happen once the road is cleared.
quests.explanation: Reopening the road returns normal access to the village once it's confirmed safe to drive on.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A man has been bitten by a dog that then ran off, and the wound is bleeding freely. Input code!
quests.hint: Say the two first-aid steps to take right away.
quests.explanation: Cleaning the bite and applying pressure lowers the infection risk and slows the bleeding before help arrives.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Animal control needs to find the dog to check if it has had its rabies shots. Input code!
quests.hint: Ask for the service trained to handle this.
quests.explanation: Animal control can locate the dog and check its vaccination records to guide the man's treatment.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The dog is found and its owner confirms its vaccinations are fully up to date. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should be confirmed back to the hospital.
quests.explanation: Confirming the vaccination record lets doctors treat only the wound, without unnecessary rabies treatment.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A gas explosion has damaged the front of a corner shop, and the owner is trapped inside. Input code!
quests.hint: Name the trained team this situation needs.
quests.explanation: A trained rescue team can safely clear debris and reach him without causing further collapse.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Rescuers can hear the owner but the doorway is completely blocked with rubble. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should be created to reach him another way.
quests.explanation: Cutting a new opening lets rescuers reach him without disturbing the unstable rubble at the door.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The shop owner has been freed with only minor cuts and bruises. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Ask for the vehicle that can treat him on the way to hospital.
quests.explanation: Even minor injuries after being trapped should be properly checked by paramedics before he goes home.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A cargo ship has run aground on rocks near the coast in rough seas. Input code!
quests.hint: Name the service trained for emergencies at sea.
quests.explanation: The coast guard has the vessels and training needed to reach a grounded ship in rough water.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Crew members report the hull is taking on water slowly near the bow. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what the crew should get ready for.
quests.explanation: Preparing early gives the crew time to gather safety equipment before the situation becomes worse.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Pumps are managing the water and the coast guard confirms the ship is stable for now. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should be done to move the ship to safety.
quests.explanation: Towing the ship off the rocks gets it to safety once the immediate flooding risk is under control.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A tornado warning has been issued for a town with an outdoor market in full swing. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should happen to the market right away.
quests.explanation: Clearing the market quickly gets people into solid shelter before the tornado has a chance to arrive.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Market stallholders are helping shoppers into the basement of a nearby stone building. Input code!
quests.hint: Say the action stallholders are taking.
quests.explanation: Clear direction to solid shelter is the most effective protection anyone can get in the short time available.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The tornado has passed the town without touching down, and the warning has been lifted. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what can now be lifted, given the good news.
quests.explanation: Ending the order once the danger has passed lets the market safely reopen for the day.
